1: # Tasks · add-marketplace-and-provider-onboarding
2: 
3: ## Phase 0 — 仓库脚手架 (0.5 day)
4: 
5: - [ ] `git init` 并接入 GitButler；`.gitignore` 含 `node_modules/`, `.env*`, `out/`, `dist/`, `.next/`, `lib/`, `cache/`, `broadcast/`
6: - [ ] 初始化 monorepo：`apps/web`、`apps/api`、`packages/contracts`、`packages/shared`、`packages/provider-sdk`
7: - [ ] pnpm workspaces 配置（`pnpm-workspace.yaml`）
8: - [ ] Turbo 配置（`turbo.json`：build / test / lint / dev pipelines）
9: - [ ] Biome 配置取代 eslint + prettier（`biome.json`）
10: - [ ] 根目录 Vitest 配置 + 各 package 共享 preset
11: - [ ] Foundry 初始化在 `packages/contracts`（`forge init --no-commit`）
12: - [ ] 根 CLAUDE.md 补 monorepo 导航说明 + 每个 package 的角色 1 行
13: 
14: ## Phase 1.1 — Solidity 合约 (1.5 day)
15: 
16: ### Marketplace.sol 存储与基础
17: 
18: - [ ] 定义 `Tool` struct（含 `version` `uint64`）+ `tools` mapping + `nextToolId`
19: - [ ] 定义 `Agent` struct（含 `operator` `dailySpendCap` `dailySpent` `dailyResetAt`）+ `agents` mapping
20: - [ ] 定义 `TaskStatus` enum + `Task` struct + `tasks` mapping
21: - [ ] 定义 `Receipt` struct + `receipts` mapping + `agentStepCounter` mapping
22: - [ ] 定义 `providerBalances` mapping
23: 
24: ### Marketplace.sol 函数
25: 
26: - [ ] `registerTool` — provider 注册新 tool，version=1
27: - [ ] `updateTool(toolId, newPrice, enabled, newSchemaHash)` — onlyProvider, version++
28: - [ ] `withdrawProvider(amount)` — CEI + nonReentrant + balance check
29: - [ ] `createAndFundAgent(maxPerCall, dailySpendCap, operator, name, goal)` — payable, mint Passport NFT
30: - [ ] `fundAgent(agentId)` — payable, onlyOwner
31: - [ ] `withdrawAgentBalance(agentId, amount)` — onlyOwner, CEI
32: - [ ] `setAgentOperator(agentId, newOperator)` — onlyOwner
33: - [ ] `setAgentDailySpendCap(agentId, newCap)` — onlyOwner
34: - [ ] `startTask(agentId, promptHash, salt)` — onlyOperator, 写 Task struct
35: - [ ] `pay(taskId, toolId, toolVersion, expectedPrice, inputHash)` — 含 §5.1 全部 invariants（operator / status / version / price / maxPerCall / balance / dailyCap 滚动重置）
36: - [ ] `completeTask(taskId, resultHash)` — onlyOperator, status Open→Completed
37: - [ ] `cancelTask(taskId)` — operator 或 owner, status Open→Cancelled
38: - [ ] `verifyAndConsumeReceipt(receiptId, expectedInputHash)` — onlyProvider, atomic verify + consume
39: - [ ] `rateTask(taskId, stars)` — onlyOwner, status==Completed, !rated, 1≤stars≤5, 调 Passport.updateReputation
40: 
41: ### Marketplace.sol 事件
42: - [ ] 完整 §5.1 末尾事件清单 emit 在对应函数
43: 
44: ### Passport.sol
45: - [ ] ERC-721 + Soulbound（override _update 让 transfer revert）
46: - [ ] `onlyMarketplace` modifier；`setMarketplace(addr)` 仅 deployer 一次性可调
47: - [ ] `mint(to, agentId)` `appendTask(tokenId, taskId)` `updateReputation(tokenId, newRep)`
48: - [ ] `tokenIdOf` `reputation` `taskHistory` view 函数
49: - [ ] `tokenURI` 链上 SVG（简版：显示 agent name + reputation 数字即可）
50: 
51: ### Foundry 测试 (test/)
52: - [ ] `Marketplace_RegisterTool.t.sol`：注册成功、version 自增、非 provider revert
53: - [ ] `Marketplace_PullPayment.t.sol`：pay 累加 providerBalances；withdrawProvider 安全；超额 revert；reentrancy 攻击合约失败
54: - [ ] `Marketplace_Receipt.t.sol`：receipt id 包含所有字段；重放 consumed revert；非 provider consume revert；inputHash 不匹配 revert
55: - [ ] `Marketplace_DailyCap.t.sol`：超 dailyCap revert；warp 24h 后 dailySpent 重置；maxPerCall 与 dailyCap 联动
56: - [ ] `Marketplace_ToolVersion.t.sol`：update 后 version++；pay 传旧 version revert
57: - [ ] `Marketplace_AccessControl.t.sol`：非 owner 调 owner-only / 非 operator 调 operator-only / 非 provider 调 provider-only 全部 revert
58: - [ ] `Passport_Soulbound.t.sol`：transferFrom revert；非 marketplace 调 mint / updateReputation revert
59: 
60: ### 部署
61: - [ ] `script/Deploy.s.sol`：先 deploy Passport → deploy Marketplace(passportAddr) → Passport.setMarketplace(marketplaceAddr)
62: - [ ] 部署到 Monad testnet（RPC URL + chain id 写 .env.example）
63: - [ ] ABI 输出到 `packages/shared/abi/` 并提交
64: 
65: ## Phase 1.2 — 后端 API (1 day)
66: 
67: ### DB
68: - [ ] Drizzle ORM 配置；连 Neon
69: - [ ] Migration 0001: `users`, `agents`, `tools`, `chain_cursor`, `operator_keys`
70: - [ ] Drizzle schema 文件 + 类型生成
71: 
72: ### Chain layer
73: - [ ] viem PublicClient (Monad testnet) + WalletClient（仅 server-side 用于 ops）
74: - [ ] ABI import 从 `packages/shared/abi/`
75: - [ ] `chain/watcher.ts`：cursor 持久化 + backfill (`eth_getLogs` 分批) + live tail (`watchContractEvent`) + reorg 检测 + finality depth 5
76: - [ ] Watcher 订阅 `ToolRegistered` `ToolUpdated` → upsert tools cache（PK: txHash + logIndex idempotent）
77: 
78: ### 路由
79: - [ ] Fastify 启动 + plugin 体系（cors / cookie / jwt / siwe）
80: - [ ] `POST /api/auth/nonce` → 生成 + 存 Redis 5min TTL
81: - [ ] `POST /api/auth/verify` → SIWE 验签 + set JWT cookie
82: - [ ] `POST /api/provider/tools/prepare-register` → 验 JWT + 构造 calldata（用 viem encodeFunctionData）+ 返回 `{ to, data, value: 0 }`
83: - [ ] `GET /api/marketplace/tools?cursor=&limit=` → 从 tools 表分页
84: - [ ] `GET /api/tools/:id` → 单 tool 详情，包含 IPFS schema_json fetch + cache
85: 
86: ### 测试
87: - [ ] Vitest 集成测试：起内存 SQLite + mocked viem，测 register tool 端到端写 DB
88: 
89: ## Phase 1.3 — Provider SDK 骨架 (0.5 day)
90: 
91: - [ ] `packages/provider-sdk/src/fastify.ts`：导出 `agentPay({ marketplaceAddr, rpcUrl, toolId, providerAddress })` Fastify plugin
92: - [ ] Plugin 在 onRequest hook 中读 5 个 header
93: - [ ] 本地算 `keccak256(rawBody)` 与 `X-AgentPay-Input-Hash` 比对
94: - [ ] viem 调 `verifyAndConsumeReceipt` 并捕获 revert reason
95: - [ ] 通过 → `req.agentPay = { receiptId, agentId, stepIdx }` 注入；不通过 → reply.code(402).header('WWW-Authenticate', `AgentPay tool=${toolId} price=${price}`).send()
96: - [ ] Vitest：mock viem client，覆盖 happy / 重放 revert / inputHash mismatch / 非 provider / RPC 超时
97: 
98: ## Phase 1.4 — 前端 (1.5 day)
99: 
100: - [ ] Next.js 15 App Router + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui 初始化
101: - [ ] wagmi v2 + RainbowKit 配置；Monad testnet `Chain` 定义到 `packages/shared/chains.ts`
102: - [ ] `lib/api.ts`：fetch wrapper 带 JWT cookie
103: - [ ] `lib/sse.ts`：EventSource wrapper + Last-Event-ID 重连
104: - [ ] `app/page.tsx`：落地页（hero + 一句价值 + Become Provider / Try as End User CTA）
105: - [ ] `app/(auth)/connect-wallet`：弹 RainbowKit modal → SIWE flow → 跳目标页
106: - [ ] `app/provider/tools/new/page.tsx`：表单（react-hook-form + zod schema）
107:   - 字段：name, description, endpoint URL, JSON Schema (Monaco editor), price (MON, 用 viem parseEther), payout address (default = connected wallet)
108:   - 提交流程：(1) POST schema JSON to Pinata 拿 hash → (2) POST `/api/provider/tools/prepare-register` 拿 calldata → (3) wagmi `sendTransaction` 钱包签 → (4) wait tx → (5) 轮询 marketplace 直到看到新 tool → 跳详情页
109: - [ ] `app/marketplace/page.tsx`：tool 卡片墙，shadcn Card；分页 20/页
110: - [ ] `app/tools/[id]/page.tsx`：单 tool 详情，展示 schema + 调用价格 + Provider 地址
111: 
112: ## Phase 1.5 — 集成 + 部署 + 冒烟
113: 
114: - [ ] Echo Provider 服务（`apps/echo-provider/`，单独 Fly.io app）：用 `@agentpay/provider-middleware`，echo input 回去
115: - [ ] 手动跑一次：连钱包 → 注册 echo tool → 链上 ToolRegistered → marketplace 列表显示
116: - [ ] Vercel 部署 `apps/web` → 接通 RainbowKit + Monad testnet
117: - [ ] Fly.io 部署 `apps/api` → 接 Neon + Upstash
118: - [ ] Fly.io 部署 `apps/echo-provider`
119: - [ ] 端到端冒烟在生产环境跑一遍
120: 
121: ## 验收
122: 
123: - [ ] `forge test` 全绿（≥ 7 个测试合约全过）
124: - [ ] `vitest run` 全绿
125: - [ ] `pnpm biome check` 全绿
126: - [ ] 生产 URL 上完整跑通 Provider 注册→列表显示
127: - [ ] `openspec-chinese validate add-marketplace-and-provider-onboarding --strict` 通过
128: - [ ] 同步 design doc：把任何实施过程中发现的合约/接口偏差回写 §5 / §6 / §9 章节
